source.license: The library repository’s own licence covers its bot and its bundling scripts, not the games. Every record’s licence field is the aggregator’s label ("Freeware" / "Shareware"), which is a description of how a site once offered the file — not a redistribution grant.
source.note: An index only: titles, years, genres, source links and availability. No game file is downloaded for it and none is hosted. A title becomes playable only when an admin records evidence that this project may redistribute that build.
